case_title: HAYNIE-METCALF, GWENDOLYN VS CITY AND COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $7,500.00 FILED BY HAYNIE-METCALF, GWENDOLYN AS TO DEFENDANT CITY AND COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR MAR-27-2007 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506
SERVICE OF COMPLAINT BY CERTIFIED MAIL
CERT MAIL TO OFFICE OF THE MAYOR CITY HALL RM 200 RETURNED TO COURT SIGNED.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF HAYNIE-METCALF, GWENDOLYN RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT CITY AND COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO $3,685.00 PRINCIPAL, $85.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $3,770.00, THE JUDGMENT REPRESENT AN AWARD OF DAMAGES IN THE SUM OF $1,185 FOR PROPERTY DURING AND LOSS OF USE; AND $2,500 FOR GENERAL AND SPECIALS DAMAGES FOR BODILY INJURY. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
